info.title: Askwerk Public API
info.description: A stable subset of Askwerk for integrators. Authenticate with an API key from Settings → API as Authorization: Bearer <key>. Errors are RFC 7807 problem details; see docs/api/errors.md.

post.summary: Gives an access token for the client credentials grant.
post.description:
application/x-www-form-urlencoded: grant_type=client_credentials, the client's id and secret (in the body or as
HTTP Basic), and optionally scope (space-separated, a subset of the client's). Errors follow RFC 6749.

401.description: invalid_client: unknown client, wrong secret, revoked or expired.

get.summary: Lists the provisioned users, oldest first.
get.description: Scope users:manage. Pages on a cursor: pass nextCursor as cursor until it is null. Deactivated users are listed with active false.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Where the page starts, from the previous page's nextCursor.

put.summary: Creates or changes a user by the host's id.
put.description:
Scope users:manage. Creates the user (without an Askwerk password) when the id is new, matching an existing
account by email once; otherwise updates email, name and role. active false deactivates, true activates again.
Owners are never provisioned; an owner's role is never changed.

delete.summary: Deactivates a user: out of the organisation, sessions ended; never deleted, their responses stay.
delete.description: Scope users:manage. PUT with active true lets them in again.

get.description: Scope webhooks:manage. Newest first, each with its last delivery; never with its secret.

post.description: Scope webhooks:manage. The secret is in this answer only; keep it to check Askwerk-Signature. At most 20 webhooks per organisation.

patch.summary: Changes a webhook's URL, events or state.
patch.description: Scope webhooks:manage. active false stops it; active true starts it again, also after it was paused for failing.

delete.summary: Deletes a webhook and its deliveries log.

get.summary: Lists a webhook's deliveries, newest first.
get.description: Scope webhooks:manage. Cursor-based: pass nextCursor as cursor for the next page.

post.description: Scope webhooks:manage. A new delivery with the same event id, so receivers that saw it already can skip it.

get.description: Scope surveys:read. Pages on a cursor: pass nextCursor as cursor until it is null.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: draft, published or closed; all when empty.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Surveys per page, at most 100; 50 when empty.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Where the page starts, from the previous page's nextCursor.

429.description: rate-limited: too many calls; see Retry-After.

get.summary: Reads one survey, with its published versions and links.

404.description: survey-not-found: no such survey in the key's organisation.

429.description: rate-limited: too many calls; see Retry-After.

get.summary: Lists the survey's responses changed after a sequence, oldest change first.
get.description:
Scope responses:read. Every new answer, change and completion gives a response a higher changeSequence; pass
nextSince as since to go on. Answers are in long format, one entry per variable of the codebook, with the value
and its label in the chosen language; an option of multiple choice appears only when chosen.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: The last changeSequence already stored; 0 for all.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Labels in this survey language; the default language when not given.

get.summary: The codebook of the survey's latest published version: every variable with its label and values.
get.description: Scope responses:read. The variables are those of the responses endpoint and of every export.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Labels in this survey language; the default language when not given.

post.summary: Starts an export of a survey's responses.
post.description:
Scope responses:read. Answers 202 with the export to poll (Location). With an Idempotency-Key header, the same
key within 24 hours gives the same export. At most three exports of an organisation run at the same time.

409.description: not-published: the survey has no published version.

get.summary: Reads an export: its status, progress and, once ready, its file.
get.description: Scope responses:read. Poll every few seconds until the status is ready, failed or expired.
Scope responses:read. Every download is in the organisation's audit log with the key as actor.

CreatedWebhook.description: A created webhook with its secret, shown only here.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null at the end.

error.description: Why the last try got no answer.

LastDeliveryView.description: The last delivery of a webhook.

variable.description: As in the codebook, e.g. SAT or SOURCE_2.

value.description: The code or number; text for open questions.

label.description: The value's label in the chosen language.

status.description: queued, running, ready, failed or expired.

format.description: excel, csv, spss, stata or json.

progress.description: Responses written of all to write.

oneOf.description: Why it failed, as a problem; null otherwise.

PublicExportFilter.description: Which responses an export holds; all when empty.

format.description: excel, csv, spss, stata or json.

layout.description: csv and excel: wide (one row per response, the default) or long (one row per answer).

values.description: csv and excel: labels (the default), codes or both.

language.description: The language of labels; the survey's default when empty.

email.description: The invited address; null for an anonymous link.

externalId.description: The host system's user id, when a host product named the respondent (AWK-13).

changeSequence.description: Grows with every change; nextSince is the last of a page.

answers.description: One entry per variable with an answer.

nextSince.description: Pass as since next time; the same as since when nothing changed.

code.description: The short code of its link.

defaultLanguage.description: The language a respondent starts in.

links.description: Where respondents open it, primary first; empty before publishing.

code.description: The short code of its link (/s/{code}).

publishedVersion.description: The latest published version; null before publishing.

languages.description: Its languages, e.g. de and en.

responses.description: Responses so far, complete and partial.

nextCursor.description: The cursor of the next page; null on the last.
The cursor of the next page; null on the last.

active.description: false deactivates; true or empty keeps them in.

PublicUserRequest.description: A user to create or change.

label.description: The question (and option or row) it stands for.

access_token.description: The token (awt_…); send it as Authorization: Bearer.

active.description: false stops it; true starts it again, also after a pause.

WebhookChange.description: A change to a webhook; what is left out stays.

paused.description: Paused for failing 3 days; active true resumes it.

WebhookView.description: A webhook as the API shows it; never with its secret.

ApiKey.description: An API key from Settings → API.
